subject: Expansion: Nexus App Suite — additional projects, API keys & rollout plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@nexusapp.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Priyanka Rao <priyanka.rao@nexusapp.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 renewal — expansion for additional apps

Hi David,

Quick note — the product org is greenlit to push Redwood into two new product lines plus a new internal admin app. That would be three additional projects under our tenant. High level asks:
- Three new API key namespaces (one per app)
- A recommended rollout cadence (staging -> canary -> prod) and estimated lead times
- Token/throughput estimate: we expect combined peak of ~250M tokens/month after ramp (current account is ~60M)
- Any term or pricing impact for adding these projects mid-contract?

We’d like to move quickly (targeting staged rollout starting mid-July). Can you send a short mutual action plan and confirmation of next steps (and a draft addendum if terms/commit change)? Looping Priyanka (ops) for visibility. I’ll add security if there are residency or compliance concerns.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Kapoor
Head of Platform — Nexus App Suite

From: david_kim@redwood.ai <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@nexusapp.com>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <priyanka.rao@nexusapp.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: Nexus App Suite — additional projects, API keys & rollout plan

Sanjay — really great to hear this is moving forward. High-level response below; I’ll put a one-page MAP and an amendment draft in a follow-up.

Short answers:
- API keys: we can provision three separate API namespaces. Typical lead time: 1 business day to create keys + optional 48–72h for internal onboarding and sandbox mapping.
- Rollout cadence: staging (week 0–2) -> canary (week 3–4, 5–10% traffic) -> prod (week 5+ with 2x autoscale ramp). I’ll attach a proposed schedule in the MAP.
- Throughput: 250M tokens/month peak is within our hosted tier but will change unit economics. We recommend a model mix (2x quantized variants for non-realtime backends + single high-throughput variant for customer-facing flows).
- Terms/pricing: because this pushes peak usage ~4x current, we should discuss a short addendum: either (A) a temporary uplift on monthly committed units with stepped ramp credits, or (B) keep base commit and apply overage pricing with a 10% volume discount once you hit the 200M band.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Priyanka to provide projected token split by app and expected start dates (staging/canary/prod).
2) We’ll send a MAP (attached) and a draft amendment (Nexus_AMendment_v2.pdf).
3) Kickoff technical onboarding week of July 15; we’ll reserve burst capacity during the first 30 days.

Cc’ing Laura to confirm commercial terms/crediting and Ben for seat/ops coordination.

Best,
David Kim
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: MAP_Nexus.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Expansion: Nexus App Suite — commercial approach

David / Ben / Monica — quick internal.

Notes on commercial approach:
- Given existing relationship and likely long term expansion, I’m comfortable offering a stepped-commit amendment: 100M additional commit for months 1–3 with a 30% ramp credit applied to overages in month 2, and then re-evaluate at month 4 for full 250M band. This preserves ROI for both sides.
- Pricing: propose $0.0008/ token for base band under new commit, drop to $0.0006/token at >=200M.
- Credit ask: marketing credit of $15k to offset initial migration work (standard for deals > $100k).

Operational asks to include in MAP: activation checklist, security review timeline (2 weeks), SSO/key rotation schedule, and a single point of contact for rate limit exceptions. Ben, can you draft the activation checklist items? Monica — please prepare a Docusign-ready amendment and include the stepped-commit table.

- Laura
VP, Commercials — Redwood Inference

Onward: I expect to keep this tight; send draft amendment to Nexus legal and Priyanka by Monday so they have time to review ahead of July kickoff.

From: Priyanka Rao <priyanka.rao@nexusapp.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@nexusapp.com>, security@nexusapp.com
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: Nexus App Suite — additional projects, API keys & rollout plan

Thanks — this helps. A couple of clarifications from ops/security before we sign:
- Data residency: two of the new apps will store logs tied to EU customers. We need confirmation that EU-region processing (and audit logs) are available for the canary/prod pods.
- Token allocation: attached a very rough split (in the MAP) but we expect App A (customer-facing chat) to be ~55% of tokens, App B ~25%, Admin ~20%.
- Can you confirm SLA/uptime for burst capacity during the first 30 days? We’ll need an exception if there’s a hard SLA ramp.

If those items are cleared, legal is okay to review the amendment next week. Looping security for residency confirmation.

—Priyanka
VP, Engineering Operations — Nexus App Suite

On Sat, Jun 2, 2028 at 08:03 AM -0700, security@nexusapp.com wrote:
> Hi Priyanka / David,
>
> Quick note from security: EU-region processing is acceptable if logs are retained per our policy and keys are scoped per namespace. We’ll need a short SOC2 artefact and a KMS integration note. Can you provide those?
>
> — Nexus Security

From: david_kim@redwood.ai <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Rao <priyanka.rao@nexusapp.com>, Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@nexusapp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: Nexus App Suite — additional projects, API keys & rollout plan

Priyanka / Sanjay — thanks for the details and the security note. Final confirmation and next steps below: 

- EU region: confirmed. We will pin canary/prod pods to the EU region for the two EU-facing apps; audit logs and retention policy (90 days) documented in the SOC2 snapshot we’ll attach to the amendment. KMS integration: we support customer-managed keys via KMS; will include the integration note.
- SLA for burst: we’ll provide a documented temporary burst SLA for first 30 days (99.0% target with credits for sustained drop below threshold) — included in the amendment.
- Docs/attachments: attaching Nexus_AMendment_v2.pdf (commercials + stepped commit table) and MAP_Nexus.xlsx (activation checklist & timeline).

Action items: 
1) Priyanka: confirm token split in the attached MAP by EOD Mon so we can finalize the commit bands.
2) Nexus Security: we’ll send SOC2 excerpt and KMS integration note by EOD Mon.
3) Redwood: Monica to prepare DocuSign link and Ben to schedule a technical kickoff for week of July 15.

I’ll queue the amendment in DocuSign and include HubSpot deal notes (link below). If this aligns, expect the DocuSign envelope early next week.

Regards,
David Kim
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference
